denominatorMethodologyNote:
"Registered" represents how many people voted compared to how many people were signed up to vote — including anyone who signed up right at their polling place, which Minnesota allows.

"CVAP" represents how many people voted compared to an estimate of how many adult U.S. citizens live in that city. That estimate comes from a U.S. Census Bureau survey, not an exact count, so it has a small margin of error.

For a few cities each year, we don't have this estimate at all — instead of guessing, we leave it blank.
